scope: Read-only public CIM source probes on TB14P-EZRA; this is not execution or acceptance of the unfinished inventory CLI.
privacy: No UUID, serial number, device identifier, software name, account name, SSID or MAC address is retained.

selected_query_results.name: driver_inventory
selected_query_results.query: SELECT DeviceID, DeviceName, Manufacturer, DriverProviderName, DriverVersion, InfName, IsSigned FROM Win32_PnPSignedDriver

selected_query_results.name: firmware_inventory
selected_query_results.query: SELECT DeviceID, DeviceName, Manufacturer, ClassGuid, DriverProviderName, DriverVersion, InfName, Status FROM Win32_PnPSignedDriver WHERE DeviceClass = 'FIRMWARE'

selected_query_results.name: software_inventory
selected_query_results.query: SELECT Name, Vendor, Version FROM Win32_InstalledWin32Program

limitations: CIM source probes were run with PowerShell and are not proof that the Rust CLI captured the same data.
Selected provider query completion times are observations, not a latency bound.
The inventory, snapshot and machine-bound recovery changes have not yet been built or accepted on Windows.
